LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Hoplite.title: citizen hoplite
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Hoplite.description: Like every free citizen, [PAWN_nameDef] bought [PAWN_possessive] own shield and spear and took [PAWN_possessive] place in the line when the city called. Between wars [PAWN_pronoun] worked a small farm of olives and barley.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Physician.title: Asklepian physician
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Physician.description: [PAWN_nameDef] trained at a temple of healing, where the sick slept in quiet halls and the physicians wrote down every symptom. [PAWN_pronoun] swore to do no harm and has kept the oath.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Philosopher.title: wandering philosopher
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Philosopher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked from city to city asking awkward questions in the market. Some paid to listen, some paid [PAWN_objective] to leave. [PAWN_pronoun] still believes no question should go unasked.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Sculptor.title: temple sculptor
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Sculptor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years in the marble yards beside a great temple, carving gods and athletes so lifelike that visitors spoke to them.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Athlete.title: games champion
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Athlete.description: [PAWN_nameDef] won the long race at the games and was given an olive wreath, a statue and free meals for life. [PAWN_pronoun] still trains every morning before dawn.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Orator.title: assembly orator
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Orator.description: In the assembly [PAWN_nameDef] could turn a vote with a single speech. [PAWN_pronoun] has argued for war, for peace and, once, for both in the same afternoon.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Strategos.title: elected general
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Strategos.description: Three times the citizens elected [PAWN_nameDef] as their general. [PAWN_pronoun] led the phalanx from the front rank and never asked anyone to stand where [PAWN_pronoun] would not.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Merchant.title: olive merchant
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Merchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] shipped oil and wine from island to island, knew every harbour master by name and never paid a full harbour fee in [PAWN_possessive] life.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Gymnasium.title: gymnasium pupil
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_Gymnasium.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] mornings wrestling and running, and [PAWN_possessive] afternoons reciting poems to a strict old teacher.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_OliveGrove.title: olive grove child
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_OliveGrove.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beating olives from the branches each autumn and treading grapes each summer on a hillside farm.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_HarbourChild.title: harbour child
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_HarbourChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran errands on the busy quays of a port city, learning to haggle in three dialects before [PAWN_pronoun] could write.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_TempleChild.title: temple servant
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_BS_TempleChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up sweeping a temple of healing, carrying water for the sick and listening to the physicians argue about cures.
